title: Typed Workflow Agent with Mastra
tagline: Build a typed approval workflow, then preserve and resume real Mastra suspension through a local SQLite store.
summary: Build a typed approval workflow, then preserve and resume real Mastra suspension through a local SQLite store.
skills: Validate typed step inputs at runtime
Make the approval invariant explicit in the plan
Suspend before effects and count failed attempts
Persist real Mastra approval state and resume it
prerequisites: TypeScript object types, unions and async functions.
Runtime validation of unknown JSON input.
An explicit approval decision and a local database file.
youWillBuild: A scratch HTML/JSON workflow review and a real Mastra run stored in SQLite with a plan-bound approval document.
usefulFor: A scratch HTML/JSON workflow review and a real Mastra run stored in SQLite with a plan-bound approval document.

stages.title: Validate typed step inputs at runtime
stages.summary: Find the workshop policy produces read intent. Update the workshop label produces write intent. A blank ID fails before a tool is chosen. The word change inside unchanged does not match the mutation-verb word boundary.
stages.languageWhy: TypeScript discriminated unions make workflow states and tool names visible to the compiler.

stages.title: Make the approval invariant explicit in the plan
stages.summary: An update action with requiresApproval=false fails. A lookup-only plan with requiresApproval=true also violates the stated representation. One through ten actions are allowed, and every action has a supported tool and nonempty query.
stages.languageWhy: A typed Plan exposes both action shape and the approval bit that must match it.

stages.title: Suspend before effects and count failed attempts
stages.summary: A lookup returning a result completes in one call. A tool returning empty text twice fails after two calls. A write without approval returns a checkpoint and zero calls; resuming that checkpoint with approved=true executes the original query.
stages.languageWhy: Async functions keep tool adapters injectable while result unions preserve terminal states.

stages.title: Persist real Mastra approval state and resume it
stages.summary: Start the authored workshop update and observe status=suspended with zero tool calls. Close the local LibSQL store, create a fresh workflow over the same SQLite file and resume by runId. Matching approval produces success and exactly one observed local tool call in the recovery test; a wrong hash fails with zero calls.
stages.languageWhy: The optional adapter uses real createStep and createWorkflow imports after the contracts are understood.
